woods 1.title: Woods
woods 1.text:
Cobby: [We are going back to Ant Hill. The priest will send people after us, so we must hurry.]

Cobby: [If you get badly wounded... I may have to leave you behind. I'm sorry, but Ant Hill depends on us to let them know what is going on. I expect you to do the same. I hope you understand. Let's move.]

---

Cobby: [Alright. We've been walking all day and it's been pretty quiet so far, but let's be extra alert tonight. I'll take the first watch like usual. Get some sleep.]

woods 3.title: Woods
woods 3.text:
You sleep for what feels like a minute until Cobby wakes you up to switch post.
You see Cobby collapse onto his sleeping bag to an instant sleep.

woods 3 2.title: Woods
woods 3 2.text:
You are now on watch.

You haven't slept much, but you are very much awake.

You sit on a tree, looking up at the glittering night sky, thinking about this adventure of your lifetime.
You recall all those fights you had, about all the monsters that you have slain... and you've never hunted anything bigger than an ant before this journey.

woods 4.title: Woods
woods 4.text:
You hear something in the dark.
A soft voice, someone whispering...

opt.text: Alert Cobby and prepare to fight

woods 4 2.title: Woods
woods 4 2.text:
You try to make out the words.

You listen carefully...

Suddenly, arrows fly from various directions.

Cobby: [We're under attack! ARGHHH!]

Cobby is hit by an arrow and collapses.

woods 5.title: Woods
woods 5.text:
Cobby: [Looks like they've caught up to us... I thought this through wrong. We should move in the dark and rest when it's bright. Let's continue moving. We'll rest tomorrow morning.]

You continue moving.

field 1.title: Field
field 1.text:
You reach a clearing of grassy fields where you had encountered the blue beetle two days ago.

Cobby: [It is getting bright. If we rest here, we'll have sight of anyone approaching us. I'll take the first watch..]

You lie down and fall asleep in seconds. It feels like you haven't slept for days...

field 2.title: Field
field 2.text:
Cobby: [Wake up... Take your watch.]

You barely get up and take the watch.
You desperately resist your eyelids from closing shut and watch for any hostiles from Stone Henge.

You somehow stay awake until sundown.
You wake Cobby up.

Cobby: [Ooh... just 5 more minutes.]

Cobby: [Alright... ok. It's night already, huh? I guess I should be thankful that there were no more ambushes. Let's get going.]

field done.title: River side
field done.text:
You continue on for 2 days, resting during the day and traveling during the night.

You pass through the goldenrod forest and the woods, and arrive back at the river.

Cobby: [We're back here again. Things have been pretty quiet so far. I just... Never mind. I don't see our old raft here. Let's set up camp here and I'll start building a raft. You go and get me some sturdy wood, like last time.]

river hunt.title: River side
river hunt.text:
You go out to the woods looking for sturdy wood.

You spot something.

river done.title: River side
river done.text:
Cobby: [Thanks.]

A few minutes later, the raft is done.

You and Cobby jump on the freshly made raft and start rowing back towards Ant Hill.

Cobby seems worried, and is completely lost in thought.

You row back in silence.

river ask concern.title: River side
river ask concern.text: Cobby: [Do you think... no, that can't be. Never mind.]

river ask cheese.title: River side
river ask cheese.text: Cobby: [Honestly, Cheese would have slowed us down. He's not fit to travel for so long. I feel kind of guilty to burden Pemmi with him.]

river crossed.title: River side
river crossed.text:
You land on the other side.

Cobby: [There is no time to waste. Let's go straight to Ant Hill. We should arrive by noon.]

You travel for the entire night and morning without rest.
The landscapes become more and more familiar as you travel.

The sun is now directly over your head, and the Ant Hill's mound is in sight.

ant hill day return.title: Ant Hill
ant hill day return.text:
You emerge from the Ant Hill woods to an open view of Ant Hill in the distance.

Cobby: [Ant Hill... looking just the same as ever. But it feels like we haven't been here for years...]

You enter Ant Hill.
Some of the people on the streets recognize you and Cobby.
They clap and holler, congratulating you for your successful mission.
Some of them notice that something is not right and start to gossip in curiosity.

You pass the gates and enter underground Ant Hill.

ant hill day return 2.title: Ant Hill
ant hill day return 2.text:
You descend into the underground temple.
The priest seems extremely surprised by your presence.
After a brief moment, he talks.

Priest: [I... don't know what to say. You made it, congratulations!]

Cobby: [No. Please listen. We were kidnapped by Stone Henge.]

Priest: [Oh...?]

Cobby: [They were killing our people... Everyone from Ant Hill that got there must've been kidnapped and fed to the spiders. We barely escaped..]

The priest looks nervous.

Priest: [I don't know what to say... Why don't you stay here and cool down for a moment?]

Cobby: [Do you... know about this?]

The priest stands still nervously, his eyes fixed on the ground.

Priest: [I'm sorry, but you shouldn't have come back.]

Several guards come out from the shadows behind and grab you and Cobby away.

opt.to: >encounter>ant hill priest guards>@ant hill expel 1>@ant hill resist

ant hill expel 1.title: Ant Hill
ant hill expel 1.text:
You hear Cobby break out of their grabs and make a run for it.

The remaining guards knock you down.
They take away your weapons, then drag you into a hidden, dark tunnel behind the temple, to be locked away...

ant hill expel 2.title: River
ant hill expel 2.text:
You spend what feels like the entire night in the dark cell alone.
Eventually the guards come in and blindfold and leash you.

They drag you out of the cell, into the streets of Ant Hill, in front of everyone you knew your whole life.

The priest announces that you have dishonorably retreated from the Full Moon's journey and consequently, your excommunication from Ant Hill.

The guards drag you out of Ant Hill to the woods.

ant hill expel 3.title: River
ant hill expel 3.text:
The priest's guards take you to the river.
They move you on a raft and unbind your shackles.

Guard: [Please don't come back to Ant Hill. We do not wish to kill you.]

They push your raft away from land.

ant hill resist.title: Ant Hill
ant hill resist.text:
You successfully take down the guards and make a run for it.

Priest: [Help! Get them!]

You hear busy footsteps from all around you.
You run out to the surface and continue past the gates.
The entrance guards watch you sprint with curiosity.
You make it to the streets by the vendors and realize that Cobby is not with you.

After a brief respite, you continue running to the woods...

ant hill escape 1.title: Ant Hill Escape
ant hill escape 1.text:
You sit on a stump and think about what just happened back in Ant Hill.

It looks like the priest knew about all that happened in Stone Henge, and doesn't want you and Cobby to tell everyone.
Now that you've escaped, he will probably not let you in back to Ant Hill.
Your old life is over.

You despair...
The only place you cant think of going to now is Stone Henge.

ant hill escape 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 2.text:
You continue moving away from Ant Hill, completely exhausted, hungry, and overloaded with emotions.
You arrive at the river where you had set up camp a week ago.

You sit by the dead bonfire and think about what to do.
The priest hold authority, and he will not let you back in to Ant Hill... Your old life is over.
You don't know where Cobby is, and it's probably not a good idea to sit here waiting for him.

The only place that you can think of right now is Stone Henge.
You start building a raft to cross the river again.

ant hill escape camp.title: River side
ant hill escape camp.text:
You are at camp.
You need to find some sturdy wood to construct a raft.

If you fall here, there won't be anyone to save you.

opt.to: >remove part>item>>custom>You build a raft.>@ant hill escape 3

ant hill escape 3.title: River side
ant hill escape 3.text:
You start rowing across the river in silence.

You feel all alone...
You wonder where Cobby is.
Did he make it out? If he did, he would probably run to Stone Henge to meet up with the others... there is nothing he can do in Ant Hill.

You feel so powerless.
The entire situation was frustrating... and sad.

ant hill escape 4-1.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-1.text:
You arrive on the other side of the river, physically and mentally exhausted.
You climb a tree and rest.

...

???: [Wake up!]

Could it be Cobby? You open your eyes.
It is Lucid, the spellcaster from the spider forest.

Lucid: [I saw your exile from Ant Hill. This must be hard for you... Are you going back to Stone Henge?]

ant hill escape 4-1 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-1 2.text: Lucid: [Ah, very well. I was on my way back to Jericho as well. We may as well accompany each other on the way, since the wildlife here are dangerous, to say the least.]

ant hill escape 4-2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-2.text:
You arrive on the other side of the river, physically and mentally exhausted.
You climb a tree and rest.

...

???: [Wake up!]

Could it be Cobby? You open your eyes.
You see a stranger wearing black leather jacket.
He doesn't look hostile.

Stranger: [Hello friend, my name is Lucid. I am a foreign visitor from far away... I was one of the kidnapped folks from the horned spider incident back in Ant Hill. I saw your excommunication and followed you here.]

opt.text: A foreign visitor in Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 4-2 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-2 2.text:
Lucid: [I had visited Ant Hill about two weeks ago. When the priest invited me in, we decided not to make a big deal about my visit to Ant Hill.]

Lucid: [Anyways, I come from a city named Jericho, and I am on my way back now. It's a bit of a journey from here, but maybe we could accompany each other on the way, and learn a thing or two about each other.]

ant hill escape 5.title: Woods
ant hill escape 5.text:
Lucid: [Let's journey on then.]

You pack all your things and start walking with Lucid.

Lucid: [It surprised me that Ant Hill depended solely on hunting monsters for food. I guess monsters are that much in abundance here.
Speaking of which, their excommunication was a very harsh decision, seeing how it's extremely dangerous out here.]

You try not to tell him much information at first, but eventually open up to him.
You tell him about the schemes of Stone Henge.

Lucid: [Oh... Yes, I had noticed something wasn't right here a while ago...]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-1.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-1.text: Lucid: [I am... on a mission from Jericho. I've come all this way to scout around... for a place to look for a specific artifact. If you ever get to Jericho, I would tell you more about my job. But I don't think you'd have any use for such knowledge here.]

ant hill escape 6-2.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-2.text: Lucid: [My understanding is that it is your priest's duty to serve the greater good. I know this could be hard for you, but he may not necessarily have bad intentions.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-3.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-3.text: Lucid: [I will accompany you to Stone Henge. But as for Ant Hill... I'm sorry, I can't help you.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-4.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-4.text: Lucid: [Jericho may sound strange for you, since you lived in Ant Hill your whole life. Imagine lots of tall towers and moving metals. Also, the monsters that you see here are much smaller near Jericho. Nevertheless, Jericho is far from paradise.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

day 1.title: Woods
day 1.text:
Lucid: [Well then. Let us journey on.]

You finish your conversation with Lucid and begin your journey to Stone Henge.

day 1-2.title: Woods
day 1-2.text:
This is your first day of journey towards Stone Henge... for the second time.

You are about the cross the goldenrod forest.

Lucid: [The forest is probably full of monsters, but is a shorter walk towards Stone Henge.]

day 1-3.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-3.text:
You decide to walk through the forest of goldenrod flowers.
Those flowers are towering over your head. They are at least three times as tall as you are and blooming with menacing yellow petals.
Pollen dust and yellow petals dance with gentle breeze.

You continue through the foliage. On and on, you see nothing but golden bloom, waving left to right in the wind... It's almost like it's a yellow butterfly waving its tendrils...

opt.to: >encounter>yellow butterfly>@journey defeat>>encounter>three fire ants>@journey defeat>>timeset>20>@day 1 end

day 1 end.title: Day 1
day 1 end.text:
You walk all day long. It is getting dark.

Lucid: [Alright. I have a handy alert spell to wake us when monsters are nearby... It only works half the time, however. What do you want to do?]

opt.text: Trust the spell and sleep well, healing to full health
Just take the watch and heal 2 health

day 1 end-1.title: Day 1
day 1 end-1.text:
You trust in the alarm spell and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to a sharp pain in your neck.
It's a giant blood red bloodquito drilling its proboscis into your flesh!
Blood gushes out of your neck.

You scream!

Lucid: [Uh... huh? What?]

day 1 end-2.title: Day 1
day 1 end-2.text:
You trust in the alarm spell and go to sleep.

...

Fortunately, you weren't ambushed that night.

day 2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2.text:
It is the second day.
You reach a clearing of green, grassy fields.

You see a giant blue beetle in the distance.

day 2 end.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end.text:
It is getting dark.
You find a place to rest.

Lucid: [So. What do you say, alarm spell or take the watch?]

opt.text: Trust the spell and sleep well, healing to full health
Just take the watch and heal 2 health

day 2 end-1.title: Day 1
day 2 end-1.text:
You trust in the alarm spell and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to a loud bustling sound.
It's a giant rat cuddling you in your sleep!

You panic and scream!

The rat attacks you.

day 2 end-2.title: Day 1
day 2 end-2.text:
You trust in the alarm spell and go to sleep.

...

Fortunately, you weren't ambushed that night.

day 3.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3.text:
It is the third day.
Lucid: [Just two more days and we'll be at Stone Henge.]

You walk across a pleasant green valley without any threats.

day 4.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4.text:
Today is the last day of travel to Stone Henge.
You trail through a forest of deciduous trees.

Lucid: [This is a good spot for a meal.]

You sit down on a large rock and start cooking bug steaks.

Lucid: [Watch out, something's approaching us!]

opt.to: >encounter>ant swarm>@journey defeat>>encounter>ant swarm>@journey defeat>>encounter>ant swarm>@journey defeat>day 4-2

day 4-2.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4-2.text:
Lucid: [That was... a lot. I'm glad I learned to cast lightning before coming to the frontier.]

You continue on the Stone Henge.

journey defeat 2.title: River side
journey defeat 2.text:
...

You open your eyes.

Lucid: [You're awake. You've passed out for quite a while.]

Every bone in your body ache.

journey defeat end.title: River side
journey defeat end.text:
...

You open your eyes.

Lucid: [I don't know how to say this... But you are crippled beyond repair. I recommend you go back to Ant Hill and beg for forgiveness.]

stone henge outskirt.title: Stone Henge Outskirts
stone henge outskirt.text:
Four days passed, and you are near Stone Henge again.

It gets dark just as you reach the outskirts.

stone henge outskirt 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 2.text:
Lucid: [Here we are. Stone Henge.]

Lucid: [You said that you were chased out of Stone Henge, right? Do you need help finding your friends?]

stone henge outskirt 3-1.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 3-1.text:
Lucid: [Stand still.]

You turn into a small mouse. Everything is so much bigger!

Lucid: [I'll be staying at the Dolomite Inn. Good luck finding your friends.]

stone henge outskirt 3-2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 3-2.text:
Lucid: [I don't blame you for not wanting to trust people anymore. But be careful. If you need any help, know that I'm staying at the Dolomite Inn for a few days.]

Lucid walks away towards the inn.
Where will you go?

stone henge caught.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught.text:
You stick to the shadows and try to sneak around.
Suddenly, a glowing orb flies toward you.

Guard: [Intruder!]

You run, but the spell light follows you.
You smack the spell orb away to the ground.
Suddenly, you feel a sharp pain in your leg. You were shot by an arrow!
You collapse.
The guards run toward you.

stone henge caught 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught 2.text:
You barely escape the guards.
Where to now?

opt.text: Sneak into Stone Henge temple again
Sneak into Stone Henge shop again

stone henge caught 3.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught 3.text:
You sneak into the Dolomite Inn and find Lucid.

Lucid: [Oh... You must be careful, the guards seem to know that you are here. You can safely rest here as long as I'm here.]

stone henge sneak.title: Stone Henge
stone henge sneak.text:
You manuever through the streets as a small mouse, trying to avoid attention as much as possible.
You climb the large stone brick stairs and enter the temple.

You clumsily skitter around the temple floor.
You hear people murmuring, and freeze in place.
You listen more carefully. It sounds like the Stone Henge priest is quietly talking to his guard...

Priest: [...So, invite the man into the temple tomorrow morning and keep looking for the other one.]

You realize he is talking about you and Lucid.
You stand there, trying to get as much information as possible, but it looks like the conversation has just ended.

Just as you try to leave, you see a valuable looking metal sigil on a table nearby.
Without hesitation, you pick it up with your mouth.
Suddenly, you feel a lot better... It seems that the sigil makes you healthier somehow.

You leave the temple and head towards Dolomite Inn.

dolomite inn.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn.text:
You arrive at the inn on the first floor of Stone Henge.
Like most other rooms in Stone Henge, there are no walls and you easily sneak into Lucid's room.

You tell Lucid what you heard in the temple.

Lucid: [Oh, don't worry about me, I've been to Stone Henge and met the priest two weeks ago. When the priest invites me over tomorrow, I'll try to get as many clues as possible to the whereabouts of your friends. As for tonight, you can sleep here. I'll make sure no one enters this room.]

dolomite inn 2.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn 2.text:
You rest.
You dream of stealing a giant pollen pemmican from Cheese at Cobby's wedding...

...

Lucid: [Hey, wake up!]

Lucid: [I was at the temple just now. I'm afraid your friend Cheese had been caught and sent to the spider forest. If you wish to save him, you must hurry!]

Lucid: [Stand still, I'll turn you into a mouse so you can sneak out quickly.]

dolomite inn 2 ask.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn 2 ask.text: Lucid: [I'm sorry, I have to return to the temple. I made an excuse to come back here to tell you about Cheese.]

stone henge tribute.title: Stone Henge
stone henge tribute.text:
You wake up.
It looks so familiar... Oh, you are in that Stone Henge spider den. Same room too.

You try to take your bindings off, but it is no use.
You realize that you walked straight into certain death, after avoiding it once with blind luck.
You despair...

stone henge tribute 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge tribute 2.text:
You hear a familiar voice in the darkness.
It is Lucid.

Lucid: [Oh, you are such a lucky person. But your luck will not last if you keep making bad choices like that.]

It is Lucid! he must have followed you here after you were caught by the guards.
Lucid takes your bindings off with a knife.

Lucid: [Come, I've learned that there are others like you in this den. Let us go deeper in... After we kill that spider behind you.]

stone henge search.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search.text:
You sneak out of Stone Henge and start moving toward the woods.

You suddenly realize, that you don't remember how to get there from Stone Henge because you were deeply hypnotized the last time you were taken there.
You get lost in the woods for some time but somehow make it back to Stone Henge.

You crawl back to the inn and wait for Lucid's return from the temple.

---

Lucid: [...Ah, a hot tempered spirit, aren't you? You should stay here one more day and try to find out where the nest is. I will help you as much as I can while I'm here. Stand still.]

Lucid turns you into a small mouse again.

stone henge search 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search 2.text:
You sneak around Stone Henge, looking for any clues to the whereabouts of Cheese or Pemmi.
You hide in the temple, listen to the guards, listen to rumors at the tavern, etc...

Hours pass.
You come back to Dolomite inn without any valuable information.

Lucid: [Ah, here you are, I was about to congratulate you. I have found Cheese and Pemmi.]

Cheese: [Oh, hey.]

Pemmi: [Oh!! You're back! Where's Cobby? How did it go in Ant Hill? It's a mess here in Stone Henge.]

Lucid: [Pemmi approached me when I visited the priest today. We had a private conversation and I learned that she is one of your friends.]

Pemmi: [I was laying low, trying to get people to see what's going on... but it's no use. Everyone trusts the priest.]

Lucid: [You did good, Pemmi. You saved Cheese before they got him to the nest.]

Cheese: [Yea. Also, it's not so bad here. Stone Henge has way better food. I don't mind living here, honestly.]

Pemmi: [No, Cheese... We need to put an end to this.]

Lucid: [Well, since we're all here, let's take some time to converse about what all happened.]

opt.text: Tell them what happened in Ant Hill

stone henge search 3.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search 3.text:
You tell them about what happened in Ant Hill.
Lucid, Pemmi, and even Cheese listen carefully as you unfold your story.

Pemmi: [So Ant Hill was also in on this whole scheme? I don't know what to do...]

Cheese: [I... I knew my dad was a prick, but wow. He kicked me out to die?]

You, Cheese, and Pemmi complain and whine for an hour before calming down.

Lucid: [Anyways. Earlier today, I've learned that there may be other people still trapped in the spider nest.]

Pemmi: [People like us? Still alive in the nest?]

Lucid: [Yes. The guards were talking about some people inside the nest.]

Pemmi: [Hmm... We should save these people. We need more people for our cause.]

Cheese: [I'll... come with, I guess.]

Lucid: [I would also like to join in. I want to take a good look at this spider nest.]

opt.text: Proceed to the spider forest altogether

stone henge search 4.title: Stone Henge Woods
stone henge search 4.text:
You follow Pemmi's lead into the spider forest.
The forest was about two hours away from Stone Henge, way farther than you remembered.

Pemmi: [We're there.]

Pemmi shows you all a giant cave-like hole under a large tree, big enough for three people to enter side by side.
It is the entrance of the spider nest that you were kidnapped to.

Pemmi: [Last time when we were here, there were only one or two spiders. Hopefully it's still that way.]

Lucid: [That probably means this den isn't one of their main dwellings. Let's get inside.]

You enter the den.

deep spider den.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den.text:
The den is covered with sticky spider webs.
Your group keep walking the dark sticky tunnel, led by Pemmi's spell light.

You walk for half an hour without seeing any spiders.
You run into a large cocoon blocking the tunnel.

Pemmi: [Uh oh... I think we've come too deep. Is this like, a mega queen spider's egg or something?]

Lucid: [Looks to me like a doorway for the spiders. There is a hole in the center. And... that is a spider.]

deep spider den 2.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den 2.text:
Lucid: [Are you good? Let's take some time to heal.]

After a brief respite, you delve deeper into the den.

You see a blue light in the distance.

Lucid: [Do you see that? a spell light! It must be the abducted survivors!]

Pemmi: [Hello?]

You hear some incoherent barking.
Four feral humans with clubs and bolas come running around the corner with hostility.
They do not seem to be open for negotiation.

deep spider den 3.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den 3.text:
Cheese: [The ferals again! This is where they live!]

Lucid: [Let's be careful. I'm sure there are more of these people.]

Pemmi: [I think it's too late to be careful, we made too much noise. Let's go in.]

You continue delving deeper in.

Eventually you enter an open cave system with glowing mushrooms lighting every corner.
You can see many shelters with ferals and primitive furniture in the distance.
There are multiple tunnel holes on the cave walls, and you notice some ferals watching you from those holes.

Cheese: [They're watching us! left, right... from up there, too!]

Lucid: [And in front of us, too. It seems we have another challenger. Get ready.]

deep spider den 4.title: Feral Cave
deep spider den 4.text:
More and more ferals peek out from the tunnels on the cavern wall to watch you and your companions in curiosity.

Lucid: [Looks like they have some kind of a village going on here. I guess they're not feral after all. Let's try to communicate with them.]

You watch Lucid try to communicate with the feral residents, but the residents just watch him with caution.

Pemmi: [Well, they aren't enthusiastic about us, and spiders could storm in at any time... I think we should just leave them be. Let's go back.]

Stranger: [Hey!]

Your group turns to find an unusually tanned man among the pale crowd.

Stranger: [Thank god, get me out of here!]

Lucid: [...He's speaking our language!]

Sugar: [My name is Sugar. I come from Ant Hill. I was kidnapped here a month ago. I was starting to wonder if I was stuck in this shit hole forever.]

Lucid: [I see. Don't worry, we're here to save you. Are there any others here?]

Sugar: [No... All dead. But first, follow me. This isn't a good spot for chit chat.]

You follow Sugar to a place in the corner away from the prying eyes of the feral residents.

deep spider den 5.title: Feral Cave
deep spider den 5.text:
Sugar leads you into a room with multiple openings.
There is a campfire in the middle with a stone cauldron on it.

Your group sit around the campfire and share your stories with Sugar.

Sugar: [..So both of those damn priests are up to no good? No fucking surprise. I never trusted that prick in Ant Hill.]

Cheese: [Yea, he's a prick.]

Sugar: [You are the priest's son, Cheese, right? So he sent you to die too? Fucking hell.]

Lucid: [So how did you end up here alone?]

Sugar: [There were others from Ant Hill and Stone Henge... But these barbarians ate them. They only spared me because I convinced them that I could craft weapons and cook meat for them.]

Pemmi: [So you cooked the other people here?]

Sugar: [What am I gonna do, baby, it's be cooked or start cooking.]

Lucid: [Well. Enough talk. If you are the only abducted outsider here, our work is done. We will leave the ferals alone and get back to Stone Henge.]

Sugar: [Sound good, but if you're all that's here, then I don't see any chance of us making it out of here.]

Lucid: [What do you mean?]

Sugar: [We're literally in a spider nest. You think they'd let us leave without a fight?]

Pemmi: [We fought our way here, and we can fight our way out. Let's get back to Stone Henge.]
